Advertisement for Faculty
Wednesday, 06 April 2016
7439 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram invites applications for the under mentioned temporary posts-
1.
Associate Professors
in  TB and Chest-1 (Open), Psychaitry-1 (Open), Radiodaignosis-1 (SC)
2.
Assistant Professors
in Biochemistry-1 (Open), Pathology-1(Open), Community Medicine-1(VJ), General Medicine-1 (1 VJ), TB and Chest-1 (Open), Psychiatry-1 (Open), Orthopedics-1 (ST), General Surgery-1 (NT),  Radiodiagnosis-2 (1 Open, 1 SC)
The applicant should send their application along with complete bio-data with necessary academic and experience certificates/testimonials to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS) by
21st April
2016
.
Qualification: MBBS with MCI recognized Post Graduate degree in concerned subject
Experience: As per MCI and MUHS norms
Pay Scale : As per rules of Kasturba Health Society
For more details call at 07152 – 284341 to 284355 (Ext. 203)  or email at
khssgm@rediffmail.com
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
